ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form large contiguous blobs on the lateral lobes; low-intensity black pixels are mapped to the trailing edge perimeter and a wide vertical column bisecting the center. Numerous low-intensity linear segments are distributed across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a sharply defined convergence point; depth is approximately 18% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies from 3 to 15 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep from the base toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-curved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized high-intensity circular pixel groups detected on the extreme distal tips and scattered within the lower central dark pigmentation region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) mapped diagonally across both the left and right high-intensity white lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks and focal clusters of barnacle colonization visible on the fluke margins and central dark region.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed high-intensity pixel clusters (water spray/droplets) overlapping the central lower section near the water line.
